basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old software developer based in Bellevue, Washington. I grew up in Seattle, so the Mariners are practically in my blood. When I'm not coding, I'm either at Safeco Field or enjoying a good hike in the Cascades. I've got a soft spot for classic rock and heavy metal, particularly bands like Burzum. My online hours are typically in the evenings and weekends, as I have a 9-to-5 job. I'm currently single and enjoy the freedom to travel and explore new music festivals.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from UW and have been working in tech since graduation. My love for music is mostly self-taught; I picked up guitar in high school and have been obsessed with discovering old and new bands alike. My knowledge about baseball, especially the Mariners, comes from years of being a dedicated fan and attending games.
